arxiv-2112-14984.creator: Davor Dragičević, Paolo Giulietti, Julien Sedro
arxiv-2112-14984.description: Abstract We establish an abstract quenched linear response result for random dynamical systems, which we then apply to the case of smooth expanding on average cocycles on the unit circle. arxiv-2303-01674.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Samuel Fernández-Menduiña, Eduardo Pavez, and Antonio Ortega. Most codec designs rely on the mean squared error (MSE) as a fidelity metric in rate-distortion optimization, which allows to choose the optimal parameters in the transform domain but may fail to reflect perceptual quality. arxiv-2306-12587.title: ARIES: A Corpus of Scientific Paper Edits Made in Response to Peer Reviews

arxiv-2306-12587.description: Abstract We introduce the task of automatically revising scientific papers based on peer feedback and release ARIES, a dataset of review comments and their corresponding paper edits. arxiv-2407-13537.description: Abstract Plane adjustment (PA) is crucial for many 3D applications, involving simultaneous pose estimation and plane recovery.
